raw_text: More leaked photos of India's stealth drone program! This one shows the drone over Ladakh near the Chinese border! Our military is years ahead of what the public knows! These images prove India has technology that rivals the US stealth program! Share widely to show India's true power!
clean_text: Telegram channel reshares AI-generated drone image as leaked military photos. Claims India has US-level stealth technology. Image is from digital art contest.
